note: This file is a configuration dictionary (not executable code). It defines model settings for a ResNetV1c-50 ImageClassifier in the MMSelfSup/MMDetection framework. No callable functions, classes, or APIs are present.
config_purpose: Defines a ResNetV1c depth-50 backbone with GlobalAveragePooling neck and LinearClsHead (1000 classes) for image classification pretraining
